video_title: Clippers AGREE to trade Kawhi Leonard to Raptors 🔥 Where does Toronto rank in East? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers move toward younger direction by trading Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers start to turn the page on this era of trying to go for it.
quotes.quote: We have seen over the last several months the Clippers start to turn the page on this era of trying to go for it. James Harden traded at the deadline, Ivica Zubac traded at the deadline, and now Kawhi Leonard moved. This all stems from them starting to move toward a younger direction. They were fine keeping Kawhi in LA, but that was not going to come with a long-term extension. Kawhi Leonard wanted to know that he had a future beyond the one year and 50 million dollars left on his deal, but my understanding is there just was none.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors emerged as the only team willing to give Kawhi Leonard a long-term commitment
quotes.excerpt: The Toronto Raptors emerged as the only team that Leonard was willing to give a long-term commitment to.
quotes.quote: Several teams over the last couple of weeks had really seriously tried to engage. Minnesota, Detroit, but they were rebuffed on multiple fronts because of the control Kawhi Leonard had because he was on an expiring deal. The Toronto Raptors emerged as the only team that Leonard was willing to give a long-term commitment to for a few reasons: his familiarity with the organization, the fact that he spent time in Toronto winning a championship, he knows members of that organization, he feels that a team can contend in the Eastern Conference, and he has relationships across that organization still.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors trade for Kawhi Leonard changes the balance of power in the East
quotes.excerpt: When you talk about something that's actually changed the balance of power in the Eastern Conference, it's this move.
quotes.quote: I know that the Giannis Antetokounmpo move was a power move by the Heat, and I think that they are going to have time over the next couple of years to really build around that. But when you talk about something that's actually changed the balance of power in the Eastern Conference, it's this move. The Raptors were this close to making the second round this year. They have got a powerful young player in Scottie Barnes who is ascendant, and they got him a running mate in this trade. Brandon Ingram had a great regular season, but Brandon Ingram did not demonstrate he was the type of player you could count on in the postseason last year. Kawhi Leonard is a player that if he is healthy, you can count on in the postseason. That's what they are investing in here.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors are ready to challenge the Knicks and other East contenders
quotes.excerpt: The Raptors, they ready to make the Knicks and everybody else who call themselves legit title contenders smell Laker cologne.
quotes.quote: The Raptors, they ready to make the Knicks and everybody else who call themselves legit title contenders smell Laker cologne. They are ready to get their feet hot. Scottie Barnes showed that in the postseason, he is ready to take that jump. He showed it last season. One could argue that he should have been in the conversation to win the Defensive Player of the Year. I know it was a gap because of Wembanyama, we get that, but when you talk about a guy that had 50 blocks, 50 steals, he was in a different category than everybody else.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard helps the Raptors become a contender in the East
quotes.excerpt: Now this is a team that is a contender in the East.
quotes.quote: If Kawhi Leonard is healthy with the growth of Scottie Barnes with the growth of their team, now this is a team that is a contender in the East. I would not call them a contender for an NBA championship, I think that they are a contender in the East from what we see on paper right now.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors need another player or two to be true title contenders
quotes.excerpt: They going to need a little player or two before I would say that they are a contender.
quotes.quote: Defensively, I think they would have to get, I hate putting people on the spot, they going to need a little player or two before I would say that they are a contender. But we can't say that they are going to contend in the East and that they can't contend for a championship if the East won the championship.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors are part of the mix but not championship contenders yet
quotes.excerpt: I will say they are a part of the mix. I don't think that this looks like a team that is contending for a championship.
quotes.quote: I will say they are a part of the mix. I don't think that this looks like a team that is contending for a championship. Contending for your conference is very different than contending for a championship in my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors deserve respect for their playoff performance against the Cavs
quotes.excerpt: You just kind of somewhat disrespected the team that they played in the first round last year.
quotes.quote: You just kind of somewhat disrespected the team that they played in the first round last year, because they played the Cavs. The Cavs went on to play in the conference finals. And now you add Kawhi Leonard, he moves the needle for them. So okay, the only duo off the top of my head that I could give credit to in the Eastern Conference that I could say that is better than Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard is Big Body Brunson and Carl-Anthony Towns.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Eastern Conference is not yet an arms race
quotes.excerpt: It's not exactly I would call an arms race in the Eastern Conference. At least not yet.
quotes.quote: It's not exactly I would call an arms race in the Eastern Conference. At least not yet. Now if LeBron James goes there, if Jaylen Brown gets traded to another team in the East, now we will see.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Roster construction and fit are crucial for team success
quotes.excerpt: It ain't always going to look how it's going to look once they get on the same team.
quotes.quote: It ain't always going to look how it's going to look once they get on the same team. Y'all remember when I was making faces and grunting when Cleveland first did the move? It be because of the fit. I get what the names look like on the paper, cute. But like when you start talking about Giannis and Bam, construction. Yeah, construction. Put the construction hats on. Because who is shooting all the threes that now we can't guard Bam and Giannis?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors lost in seven to a team that got swept in the next round
quotes.excerpt: The Raptors lost in seven to a team that got swept in the next round.
quotes.quote: The only thing that I was trying to say, the Raptors lost in seven to a team that got swept in the next round. That was the only thing that was my only argument. And they are a lot better, and they are a lot better.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' reaction to Giannis choosing Miami over Boston
quotes.excerpt: When the Knicks found out that Giannis was going to Miami instead of Boston, how you think they felt?
quotes.quote: When the Knicks found out that Giannis was going to Miami instead of Boston, how you think they felt? Happy. Very happy.
